quest.title: Big Business
quest.description: Having lost the invoices to a large business venture, Landa is currently beside himself with anxiety...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: This is really bad...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened to you?

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: Oh, you're a traveler... Well, you see, I'm a merchant, and I often shuttle between Mondstadt and Liyue on business.

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: I had just closed a big deal in Mondstadt, and was getting ready to deliver the invoices back to my boss...

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: But I never imagined that I'd be attacked by monsters while passing through this area.

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: I couldn't fight them off, so I could only flee for my life, and ended up stumbling my way into this inn.

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: But I've run off, and left all the invoices behind... Could I ask you to get them back for me?

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: That's wonderful! I remember the places I passed by as I ran, more or less. Here, let me mark them for you...

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: I placed all the invoices inside a box. It shouldn't be too hard to find, so please, help me out!

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: For wine, of course. What other business would one do in Mondstadt, anyway?

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: This is a huge deal. If anything goes wrong, my boss will hang the loss on me for sure.

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: Please help me out. I've marked all the rough locations out for you.

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: I placed all the invoices inside a box. It shouldn't be too hard to find, so please, help me out!

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: My boss? Uh, well, it's a really rich merchant in Liyue. Really rich.

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: Oh, just don't ask too much. I'm just the errand runner, I don't know that much about the boss.

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: But if I mess this one up, I'm going to lose this errand-running job for sure.

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: Please help me out. I've marked all the rough locations out for you.

response.speaker: Landa
response.text: I placed all the invoices inside a box. It shouldn't be too hard to find, so please, help me out!

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: This doesn't seem to have any use...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me. Have you seen a box?

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: A box? Well, I did pick one up.

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: I already had a look inside, and it was a batch of invoices. Seems like someone was doing a real huge business venture.

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: Oh me, oh my, I wonder how much the owner of this box would pay to have it back?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...What do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: Hey, don't look so nervous. I was just pulling your leg.

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: The value of the goods on those invoices is not low by any means. Makes one wonder which big shot in Liyue it was who signed off on it.

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: I've got a sense of time and place. I'm not about to kick the hornet's nest just because I can.

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: Still, don't you think it's a bit unreasonable for you to just take this and leave after all the time and effort I've spent guarding it?

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: How about this? Let's barter. It's the most traditional way of solving such problems.

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: You fetch me 3 Noctilucous Jades, and I'll give you the invoices. How does that sound?

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: I mean, these 3 Noctilucous Jades probably aren't worth anything compared to the things listed on those invoices.

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: Well, hop to it then. When you're back, we'll trade, one for one.

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: Oh, you don't know? So you're just here to do someone else's work. Well, that's just fine.

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: Let me give you some advice: you're better off not asking too much about transactions of this scale.

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: Alright, go get me those Noctilucous Jades, and I'll give you the invoices. Then you can pass it on to the person who requested your services.

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: All done, no mess or fuss.

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: Did you get those Noctilucous Jades?

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: Did you find the invoices?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Found them all.

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: Thank you, truly! This is wonderful. I'm so glad that nothing went wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: If these invoices were lost, I have no idea how angry my boss would have been.

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: You want to ask what business these invoices were written for, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, I really can't tell you. It's a secret.

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: Well, here's your remuneration, please take it... Wait a moment. Why has this box been opened?

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: ...You met someone out in the wild who took a look at it after picking it up?

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm dead. Dead. Dead! This... this won't do. I have to tell the boss quickly...

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: Oh, don't worry, I'm not suspicious of you. I mean, I did do my homework regarding your...

dialogues.speaker: Landa
dialogues.text: Ahem. Well, I need to find a way to contact my boss. Please carry on with your business.

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: Not bad. I'll take them. Here's the invoices, take care of them now.

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: Alright then, best you be off. The person who hired you must be a real bundle of nerves right now.

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: I only had a little look. That won't get me in trouble, will it?
